description: Reproductions of publicly reported Godot bugs (README.md has the sources and measurements). agents/reported_bench.py renders each one and the clean game on the smoke route and these routes. minDeltaX is about 80% of the clean game's measured delta-x on the route, as smoke's 400 is of 485. walk-left is the route for the platform draw-order finding, which is not a bug variant.
